source: User-approved source audit and prioritized roadmap, 28 October 2026
epics: Protect completed bytes and recover from expired links, lost context, network interruptions and storage failures.
Provide persistent Brave and Firefox integration, version diagnostics, explicit permissions and predictable handoff rules.
Identify the intended video, offer real formats and metadata, and expand supported non-DRM media workflows.
Complete file management, queue editing, categories, bulk workflows, history and advanced scheduling.
Add background controls, notifications, desktop conveniences, accessible customization and automation entrypoints.
Add explicit authentication and proxies, live bandwidth control, usage policies and measured transfer improvements.
Publish the original source, establish release gates, deliver trusted updates and provide clear diagnostics and compatibility evidence.

tickets.title: Refresh expired download addresses without discarding valid partial data
tickets.context: Jobs store their current URL but have no refresh-address command or durable original-page identity. A renewed signed URL currently becomes a separate job.
tickets.scope: Persist the original page and a refresh correlation identifier; add backend and desktop refresh actions; accept a fresh browser handoff into the existing job.
criteria: A local fixture expires a URL halfway through a file; a fresh browser URL refreshes the existing job rather than adding a duplicate.
Resume retains bytes only when representation identity, size and validators establish the same file; changed content requires an explicit restart.
The completed hash matches the fixture and refresh correlation does not accept an unrelated file.

implementation_notes: Refresh the existing job only after file identity validation; preserve idempotency and durable ranges.
Keep shared Rust/TypeScript interfaces and existing SQLite histories compatible; use versioned/defaulted fields as applicable.
out_of_scope: Replacing a source is not permission to append bytes from a different representation.
Unrelated roadmap features and release publication/host installation unless explicitly assigned.

tickets.scope: Persist an allowlisted, non-secret public context and original-page metadata; keep cookies and credentials ephemeral; identify jobs requiring browser reauthorization.

No cookies, bearer tokens or credential-bearing page queries appear in persisted public context or diagnostic exports.
A signed-in job lacking credentials presents a browser refresh action and resumes the same job after an approved fresh handoff.

implementation_notes: Persist only explicitly allowlisted public metadata, separate from the in-memory credential context.
Keep shared Rust/TypeScript interfaces and existing SQLite histories compatible; use versioned/defaulted fields as applicable.
out_of_scope: Do not persist cookies, bearer tokens, signed page-query parameters or browser profile databases.
